privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.overview: Share Heart Rate lets you stream heart rate readings from a Garmin watch to a web page that anyone with the link can open. This policy explains what data we process for that feature.
privacy.data: When you create a sharing session from the watch app, we store a random session identifier, a session secret used by the watch to upload readings, heart rate values (beats per minute), and timestamps for those readings. We do not ask you to create an account, and we do not collect your name, email address, or Garmin account credentials through this service.
privacy.sharing: A session link (or QR code) is enough to view that session’s live heart rate. Anyone who has the link can open the web viewer. Do not share the link if you do not want others to see your readings. The session secret stays on the watch and is not required by viewers.
privacy.cookies: We may store a small locale cookie so the website can show English or Spanish based on your browser language preference. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.retention: Session data is kept so the live viewer and history chart can work while you are sharing. Sessions may be deleted or expire over time. Stop the watch app and stop sharing the link when you no longer want readings to be available.
privacy.thirdParty: The website and API are hosted on Vercel. Heart rate session data is stored in Google Firebase Firestore. Those providers process data only as needed to run the service.
privacy.contact: If you have questions about this policy or want a session removed, open an issue in the project repository or contact the app publisher listed on the Connect IQ Store listing.

landing.tagline: Stream live heart rate from your Garmin watch to anyone with a link.
landing.watchAppDescription: Install Share Heart on your Garmin watch from Garmin Connect IQ.
landing.step1: Open the app on your watch — it creates a sharing session.
landing.step2: Scan the QR code on the watch to open the live viewer.
landing.step3: Heart rate updates every 30 seconds while the app is running.

session.notFoundDescription: This session does not exist or has expired.
session.waitingFirstReading: Waiting for first reading from the watch
session.chartDescription: Showing the last hour. Updates automatically while the watch app is running.
